go_semantics: Both trees declare go 1.22 in go.mod. The labels assume Go 1.22 language semantics and standard library, built by a Go 1.22 or later toolchain with this module as the main module.

expected_findings.defect: Removing the ownership check lets any authenticated caller delete any document, although the doc comment still says only the owner or an administrator may.
expected_findings.rationale: `ErrForbidden` is no longer returned anywhere, and `Delete` now proceeds for every caller once the document exists, which is a broken access control.
